clause.quote: Therefore all CESR primitives MUST employ [[ref: mid-padding]] as defined.

description: A 0B signature in a binary-domain group whose four pad bits, between the code and the value, are not zero. The specification has no sentence saying such a stream must be rejected; the assertion rests on the cited MUST, which this stream violates, so it cannot be decoded as a conforming stream. Any rejection satisfies the assertion; the class in the note is informative.
title: Reject a binary-domain primitive whose pad bits are not zero
